import pathlib,re,difflib,hashlib,json
root=pathlib.Path('/tmp/cyv65/contracts')
f=root/'BeefyVaultCurveYieldV8cyvlSDT.sol'
before=f.read_text()
after=before
out=pathlib.Path('/tmp/v70-report');out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def replace(a,b):
    global after
    assert after.count(a)==1, ('expected exactly one source anchor',a,after.count(a))
    after=after.replace(a,b,1)
replace('bool private fixedStrategy;','bool private fixedStrategy;\n    bool private supportsEmergencyWithdraw;')
replace('bool _fixedStrategy\n    )','bool _fixedStrategy,\n        bool _supportsEmergencyWithdraw\n    )')
replace('fixedStrategy = _fixedStrategy;','fixedStrategy = _fixedStrategy;\n        supportsEmergencyWithdraw = _supportsEmergencyWithdraw;')
# Keep the existing authorization and fixed-strategy restrictions and update the flag
# atomically at the existing strategy assignment. No new setter or external call.
m=re.search(r'\bfunction setStrategy\s*\(([^()]*)\)',after)
assert m and ',' not in m.group(1), 'unexpected existing setStrategy signature'
start=m.start(); brace=after.index('{',m.end()); depth=1; end=brace+1
while depth:
    if after[end]=='{': depth+=1
    elif after[end]=='}': depth-=1
    end+=1
body=after[start:end]
assert 'onlyOwner' in body and 'if (fixedStrategy) revert StrategyFixed();' in body, body
a=re.search(r'^([ \t]*)strategy\s*=\s*[^;]+;',body,re.M)
assert a and len(re.findall(r'(?m)^\s*strategy\s*=\s*[^;]+;',body))==1, body
body=body[:a.end()]+'\n'+a.group(1)+'supportsEmergencyWithdraw = _supportsEmergencyWithdraw;'+body[a.end():]
body=body.replace(m.group(0),m.group(0)[:-1]+', bool _supportsEmergencyWithdraw)',1)
after=after[:start]+body+after[end:]
# Limit the condition change to the existing strategy emergency dispatch.
rx=r'if\s*\(emergency\)(\s*\{\s*[^;\n]*\.emergencyWithdraw\([^;\n]*\);)'
after,n=re.subn(rx,r'if (emergency && supportsEmergencyWithdraw)\1',after)
assert n==1, ('unexpected emergency dispatch count',n)
assert after.count('supportsEmergencyWithdraw')==8, after.count('supportsEmergencyWithdraw')
diff=''.join(difflib.unified_diff(before.splitlines(keepends=True),after.splitlines(keepends=True),fromfile='v69/BeefyVaultCurveYieldV8cyvlSDT.sol',tofile='v70/BeefyVaultCurveYieldV8cyvlSDT.sol'))
assert diff and before!=after
(out/'BeefyVaultCurveYieldV8cyvlSDT-before-v69.sol').write_text(before)
(out/'BeefyVaultCurveYieldV8cyvlSDT-after-v70.sol').write_text(after)
(out/'vault-capability-diff-v1.patch').write_text(diff)
f.write_text(after)
print('SOURCE_DIFF_BEGIN\n'+diff+'SOURCE_DIFF_END',flush=True)
print('SOURCE_HASHES',json.dumps({'before':hashlib.sha256(before.encode()).hexdigest(),'after':hashlib.sha256(after.encode()).hexdigest()}),flush=True)
